# crosswork_collection_jobs (Resource)

This resource can manage a bulk collection job of Crosswork.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_collection_jobs" "example" {
  application_id = "cwtest-app"
  context_id     = "cwtest-context"
  collector_type = "CLI"
  devices        = ["build-router-1"]
  destination    = "cwtest-dest-kafka"
  cli_sensors = [
    {
      command = "show version"
      cadence = 60
      topic   = "cwtest-topic"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) Application id of the job, which with the context id identifies it. A change replaces the job
- `collector_type` (String) Collector type of the job. A job holds only the sensors of its collector type, `cli_sensors` for `CLI` and `snmp_sensors` for `SNMP`. A change replaces the job
  - Choices: `CLI`, `SNMP`
- `context_id` (String) Context id of the job, unique within the application id. A change replaces the job
- `destination` (String) Name of the data destination that receives the output, as `crosswork_data_gateway_destinations` names it

### Optional

- `cli_sensors` (Attributes List) CLI commands the job runs on the devices, for the collector type `CLI`. Each command has its own cadence and topic (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cli_sensors))
- `device_tag` (String) Tag whose devices the job collects from, resolved by Crosswork when the job runs. Set either this or `devices`. A change replaces the job
- `devices` (Set of String) Inventory ids of the devices the job collects from, in any order. Set either this or `device_tag`. Crosswork does not accept a change of the devices of a job, so a change replaces the job
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `snmp_sensors` (Attributes List) SNMP objects the job collects from the devices, for the collector type `SNMP`. Each object has its own cadence and topic (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snmp_sensors))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--cli_sensors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cli_sensors`

Required:

- `cadence` (Number) Seconds between two runs of the command, at least 1
- `command` (String) CLI command to run, for example `show version`
- `topic` (String) Topic the output of the command is sent to on the destination


<a id="nestedatt--snmp_sensors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `snmp_sensors`

Required:

- `cadence` (Number) Seconds between two collections of the OID, at least 1
- `oid` (String) OID to collect, one for each sensor
- `operation` (String) SNMP operation
  - Choices: `WALK`, `SCALAR`, `TABLE`, `COLUMN`
- `topic` (String) Topic the output of the object is sent to on the destination

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_collection_jobs.example "<application_id>,<context_id>"
```
